The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Trait & core dispatch
- **`field_index_base.rs`** — Changed the `PayloadFieldIndex::filter` trait method return type to `OperationResult<Option<Box<dyn Iterator<...>>>>`, and updated the `FieldIndex::filter` delegating method to match.

## Implementations updated to return `OperationResult<Option<...>>`
- **`numeric_index/mod.rs`** (`NumericIndexInner<T>`) — `Ok(None)` when no range condition applies (via `let ... else`), `Ok(Some(empty))` on failed boundary checks, `Ok(Some(iter))` for UUID matches and valid ranges.
- **`map_index/mod.rs`** (all three: `str`, `UuidIntType`, `IntPayloadType`) — wrapped in `Ok(...)`; the UUID impl's internal `?`-on-`Option` (`.ok()?`) was rewritten to `let Ok(..) else { return Ok(None) }`.
- **`geo_index/mod.rs`** — rewrote `.ok()?` early-returns to `return Ok(None)` and wrapped all branches in `Ok(Some(...))` / final `Ok(None)`.
- **`full_text_index/text_index.rs`**, **`bool_index/{mutable_bool_index,mod,simple_bool_index}.rs`**, **`null_index/mutable_null_index.rs`** — wrapped returns in `Ok(...)`.

## Caller
- **`struct_payload_index.rs`** — `query_field` now returns `OperationResult<Option<...>>`, propagating the error with `?` from `field_index.filter(...)` (replacing `find_map`). Its caller in `iter_filtered_points` collects into `OperationResult<Option<Vec<_>>>` via `.collect::<OperationResult<_>>()?`, preserving the "any `None` → fall back to full scan" semantics while surfacing errors.

All other `.filter(...)` call sites are inside `#[cfg(test)]` modules, which the verification system patches automatically — I left those untouched per your instructions.
